name: Summer Art Camp
description_short: A drop-off morning art camp (9:00am-12pm) for ages 6-11 at the Art Pop studio in Somerset, MA. Campers spend three hours a day on process art projects with many materials; themed weeks such as Adventure Makers Expedition are offered, and an Open Create add-on extends the day. Campers bring a snack and lunch; nut-free studio.
